## Meta Product and Feature Updates

Meta's product updates center on AI assistants, creator tools, advertising automation, business messaging, Threads, and Reality Labs devices.

## New Product Launches
- Meta AI assistant experiences across consumer apps
- Llama open models for developer and enterprise experimentation
- Quest hardware and mixed-reality platform improvements

## Major Feature Updates
- AI creative and ad optimization tools for marketers
- Business messaging enhancements across WhatsApp and Messenger
- Feed, Reels, and recommendation improvements using AI systems

## Platform Enhancements
Meta continues to invest in AI infrastructure, ad measurement, business messaging, and cross-app engagement.

## Product Deprecations
- Platform APIs and ad tools may change as privacy, measurement, and product strategies evolve

## Regulatory Updates
Contracts and campaigns should consider privacy, consent, content moderation, brand safety, and regional regulatory obligations.
